name: critique
context_rationale: The skill orchestrates from the main agent thread — reads vault files, runs tools, gates build-slice, and halts on TRI-1 user input — while spawning a fresh-context 'critique' subagent for the adversarial heavy lifting.
summary: Adversarial review of the current slice's design by a separate Critic AI persona. Spawns a 'critique' subagent with 9 fixed attack dimensions, writes findings to critique.json, and gates /build-slice behind a user-owned TRI-1 triage step. Mandatory in Standard (medium/high tier) and Heavy modes; skippable on low-tier slices with no mandatory triggers. BLOCKED verdict prevents auto-advance; CLEAN or NEEDS-FIXES proceed to /build-slice.

name: critique-review
context_rationale: The skill orchestrates from the main agent thread — reads existing critique.json and slice artifacts, invokes the meta-Critic subagent, runs a structural audit, and hands control back to /critique Step 4.5 TRI-1 which requires the main thread's user-input gate.
summary: Dual review (DR-1) of the first Critic's output for per-slice false positives, false negatives, and severity miscalibrations. Spawns a 'critique-review' subagent that independently re-applies the 8 review dimensions against mission-brief, design, and the first Critic's critique.json. After receiving the meta-Critic's output, runs critique_review_audit to validate structure, then hands findings back to /critique Step 4.5 TRI-1 for user reconciliation. Recommended for high-tier and auth/data-model/contract slices; optional for low-tier slices.

name: code-review
context_rationale: The skill orchestrates from the main agent thread — resolves the live git diff (including uncommitted working-tree changes), reads vault slice files, invokes the code-Critic subagent, and updates milestone.json — requiring the current repo state only accessible in the main thread.
summary: Adversarial review of the slice's code diff by a separate code-Critic AI persona (CRSI-1). Resolves a union-of-three-sources git diff (working tree, untracked, and committed-in-branch) filtered to in-scope paths, then spawns a 'code-review' subagent that attacks the diff along 9 dimensions with path:line specificity. Writes findings to code-review.json and updates milestone.json; advisory only in v1. Auto-advances to /validate-slice after writing code-review.json.

name: critic-calibrate
context_rationale: The skill itself orchestrates from the main agent but all heavy analysis is delegated to a fresh-context 'critic-calibrate' subagent; the skill only collects and presents inputs and logs results, which does not depend on the main thread's current slice state.
summary: Cross-slice meta-skill that mines 'Missed by Critic' and 'Critic calibration' entries from the last N (default 15) archived reflections to identify blind-spot patterns in the Critic prompt. Spawns a 'critic-calibrate' subagent that classifies patterns, applies a >=3-distinct-slices threshold, and produces 0-3 evidence-backed proposals. Proposals are presented one-at-a-time to the user for accept/modify/reject; this skill never auto-applies edits to the Critic agent prompt. Logs every run to critic-calibration-log.json for longitudinal effectiveness tracking.
